CTKD
Taekwon-Do | Lethbridge, AB
{{theme_name}} Parents Night Out
Hey whats going on Champions,
{{theme_tagline}} On {{event_date_day}}, we turn the place into a {{theme_name}} arena for our Parents Night Out, and your kid is invited.
{{event_date_day}}{{doors_time}} to {{pickup_time}}Ages {{age_range}}{{price_per_child}} per child
The night
No screens. The real thing.
Kids drop in with a squad and fight through six stations: objectives, a shrinking play area, and a last-squad-standing finale. They earn tickets all night for effort, teamwork and being a good teammate, then spend them at the Prize Store before pickup. Food is on us.
Bring your own blaster
Your child can bring their own blaster if they have one. It just has to fire standard darts. We supply all the darts, so there is nothing to buy. Write their name on it and it goes home with them.
Safety
Coaches run every round
Eye protection is provided and worn the whole time. Arm's length minimum, never at the head, and darts get swept between rounds. Every non-member guest needs a signed waiver, and kids are released only to the person you name at check-in.
GRAB A SPOT →
Only {{capacity}} spots, and these sell out. A non-member friend comes free, so this is the easy one to invite someone to.
Three hours they will talk about all week, and a night off for you. See you {{event_date_short}}.
Love you all,
The CTKD Team
CTKD
Building strength. Building community.
